title: PDF splitter: by pages, ranges or selected pages
description: Split a PDF into parts: every page as a separate file, by ranges like 1-3, 4-10, or just the pages you select. In your browser, nothing is uploaded.

ui.ranges: Ranges — each becomes a separate file
ui.badRanges: Enter pages from 1 to {max} separated by commas, e.g. 1-3, 4-6
